headline: Western Fronts Ignite as Bases Flip Frequently
war_summary: Six hours after the last edition the western arc has grown still hotter. Fishermans Row now records forty‑nine ownership changes in the past day, up from thirty‑six, with the latest flip at 08:53 UTC. Weathered Expanse climbs to thirty‑five flips, Deadlands to fifteen, and Stlican Shelf to twenty‑one, each showing fresh timestamps this morning. Lykos Isle holds at nineteen flips, Godcrofts rises to eleven, and Marban Hollow adds six. Tempest Island and Farranac Coast have cooled to six and five flips respectively. Callahans Passage remains steady at five. Casualty streams tell a mixed tale: Stonecradle’s losses have exploded to over four hundred colonial and three hundred warden casualties per hour, both accelerating sharply; Weathered Expanse, Linn Mercy, Loch Mor and Marban Hollow stay heavy but are cooling; Clahstra, Callahans Passage, Deadlands and Kings Cage show easing loss rates. Enlistment rates are rising in Godcrofts, Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse, hinting at fresh reinforcements. The deep Warden interior (Acrithia, Allods Bight, Callahans Passage, etc.) and the Colonial‑held south (Heartlands, Great March, etc.) remain quiet with no base turnovers.
